These tiny projects were generated from an original two-animation test skeleton
with the licensed Spine CLI (3.8.99, 4.0.33, 4.1.17 and 4.2.43). They contain one
bone, one slot, a default skin and no image files. `first_animation` makes the
initially transparent slot visible; `second_animation` contains a rotation key.

The active flags were verified against copies saved after selecting each action
in the corresponding official editor. Local directory strings were replaced
with `C:/fixture`. There are no game assets, editor executables or license data.
`states.json` records the independently checked active-byte offsets in the
decompressed sanitized fixtures.
